source.issued_by: Revenue and Disaster Management Department (Disaster Management Wing, D.M.III(2))

definitions.hut: A temporary, makeshift unit, inferior to a Kutcha house, made of thatch, mud, plastic sheets, etc., traditionally recognized as a hut by State/District authorities.

items.assistance_type: Fully damaged/destroyed and severely damaged houses
notes: As printed in the G.O., this rate is listed only for this house type and area combination; the G.O. does not state a rate for the other combinations
items.summary: Housing: Fully damaged/destroyed and severely damaged houses. Damage: Fully damaged/destroyed or severely damaged. House type: Pucca. Area: Plain areas. Benefit: Rs. 1,20,000 per house. As printed in the G.O., this rate is listed only for this house type and area combination; the G.O. does not state a rate for the other combinations.

Housing: Partially damaged houses. Damage: Partially damaged. House type: Pucca. Benefit: Rs. 6,500 per house. Other than huts. Damage must be at least 15%.
Housing: Partially damaged houses. Damage: Partially damaged. House type: Kutcha. Benefit: Rs. 4,000 per house. Other than huts. Damage must be at least 15%.
Housing: Damaged/destroyed huts. Damage: Damaged/destroyed. House type: Hut. Benefit: Rs. 8,000 per hut.

items.benefit_text: 10 kg rice for each case of damaged huts

Housing: Cattle shed attached with house. Benefit: Rs. 3,000 per shed. Cattle shed attached with house.
